name: Kadmos Capital
decision_note: London-based early-stage deep-tech VC (EuVECA, UK FCA) with no office or portfolio company in Czechia; it appeared only as an existing investor in Antiverse's round led by the Czech Soulmates Ventures (Mar 2026).

evidence.quote: Kadmos Capital is a London-based venture capital firm founded in 2021 by Remy Kesrouani and John Gebeily, investing at the intersection of science, technology and ambition.
The round was led by Soulmates Ventures with participation from Innovation Investment Capital, DOMiNO Ventures, and existing investors DBW, Kadmos Capital, and i&i Biotech Fund

analyst_notes: Screened as a Soulmates Ventures co-investor. The own site kadmoscapital.com is JavaScript-rendered (no text retrievable), so identity and location come from the F4 directory profile (class D): London HQ (Pembridge Road, W11), founded 2021 by Remy Kesrouani and John Gebeily, UK FCA-registered EuVECA manager (FRN 954103 per F4, not checked in the FCA register), themes AI & data, TechBio and sustainability (not recorded as sector_focus because the source is a third-party directory, not the investor), pre-seed/seed and selectively Series A, reported AUM about USD 52.6m (Dealroom via F4 - not used as capital). No Czech office, team member or Czech portfolio company was found; Antiverse is a UK company. Hence S2. No UK registry ID was looked up, so legal_entities is empty.
